title: CLR/123/2017 of Irshad Ahmad AND OTHERS Vs Smt. Shikha Ghosh AND OTHERS

paras.text:
CLR No. 123 of 2017
Honíble Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.
Mr. B.S. Negi, Advocate for the
revisionists.
Mr. Neeraj Garg, Advocate for the
caveator.
Having heard the learned counsel
of the revisionists as well as caveator
landlord, it transpires that the whole
case of the revisionists is based on the
so called settlement dated 30.3.1998
entered into between the original tenant
Makbool and the original landlord Shri
A.P. Ghosh. This settlement was got
drafted on the stamp paper purchased
on 30.5.1996 in the name of Shri Irshad
Ahmad (son of Shri Makbool Ahmad) as
disclosed in the impugned judgment.
There was no question of such
settlement between Shri Irshad Ahmad
and Shri A.P. Ghosh because the father
(Shri Makbool Ahmad) of Shri Irshad
Ahmad, who is also the father of rest of
the two revisionists, passed away on
28.11.2013, that is the reason, the
respondents pleaded such settlement to
be a forged document and such
pleadings has been upheld by the
learned Trial Court in the impugned
judgment on 18.8.2017. Such
settlement is in the nature of agreement
to sale which has also been disbelieved
by this very court in yet another revision
no. 149/2016 presented by the tenant
in its order dated 25.10.2016.
I think there is no force in this
revision. It is hereby dismissed at the
threshold.
